mapper.select: SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM kit_knowledge_node WHERE node_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY parent_id

SELECT node.* FROM kit_knowledge_node node WHERE node.node_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND node.deleted = 0 AND node.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kit_knowledge_directory_role grant_row JOIN kit_knowledge_node scope_directory ON scope_directory.id = grant_row.directory_id AND scope_directory.node_type = 'DIRECTORY' AND scope_directory.deleted = 0 WHERE grant_row.deleted = 0 AND grant_row.permission_type IN ('SEARCH', 'UPLOAD', 'MANAGE') AND grant_row.role_code IN
#{roleCode}
AND node.directory_path LIKE CONCAT(scope_directory.directory_path, '%') )
ORDER BY node.name ASC, node.id ASC
